notes: The Recreation Commission's last half-year, January to June 1950: field-house contracts for Byxbee (Merced Heights), Miley (Cow Hollow), Longfellow (Alice Chalmers) and Presidio Heights, the Chinese Recreation Center contract, Merchant's last architect contracts, and the naming of the Peixotto, Joseph Lee, Alice Chalmers and Merced Heights playgrounds.

coverage.remaining: Routine items not curated. Not placed: the Richmond Playground contract (J. Henry Harris, May 4, 1950; two Richmond pages) and the Funston field-house heating contract (minor). The duplicate item minutesrecreati1950sanf_1 is the same half-year.
